summary.text: Dr. Anna R. Kelles is the incumbent Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 125 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A nutritional epidemiologist and former Tompkins County legislator, she represents the 125th Assembly District, which includes Tompkins County and part of Cortland County.

paragraphs.text: Anna Kelles earned a dual bachelor's degree in Biology and Environmental Studies from Binghamton University in 1997 and a Ph.D. in Nutritional Epidemiology from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 2008.

She spent four years in Ecuador, where she worked as a high school biology teacher and an ecological guide, and later taught at Ithaca College, directed the School of Applied Clinical Nutrition at New York Chiropractic College, and was a lecturer at Cornell University from 2015 to 2017.

Kelles served in the Tompkins County Legislature from 2015 to 2020, chairing its Health and Human Services, Planning, Development and Environmental Quality, and Housing and Economic Development committees.
She represents the 125th Assembly District, which includes Tompkins County and part of Cortland County, and chairs the Commission on Rural Resources.
She is also a member of the Agriculture, Correction, Environmental Conservation, Health, Higher Education and Housing committees.
